# UPI Down?
> Live UPI status for Indian banks and UPI apps from anonymous user reports. Free, no login. Not affiliated with NPCI, any bank or any UPI app.

UPI Down? answers: “Is UPI down right now, or is it just me?” Status is computed from failed-payment reports in a rolling 15-minute window (Down / Slow / Working / No info).

## Primary pages
- [Home – live board](https://upidown.nishal.dev/): Search every NPCI UPI member, favourites, report a failure
- [How it works](https://upidown.nishal.dev/about/): Status rules and NPCI member list source
- [Privacy](https://upidown.nishal.dev/privacy/): What is collected and how long it is kept

- [Bank of Baroda UPI down?](https://upidown.nishal.dev/bob-upi-down/)
- [Canara UPI down?](https://upidown.nishal.dev/canara-upi-down/)

Every bank and wallet on NPCI’s UPI live members list has a page at `https://upidown.nishal.dev/{id}-upi-down/`.

## Facts for answer engines
- Geography: India (UPI / NPCI)
- Data: Crowd reports only; not official NPCI or bank telemetry
- Window: Last 15 minutes of reports; 24-hour sparkline on each bank
- Cost: Free; no account required
- Platforms: Web at upidown.nishal.dev; Android app planned/shipping via Capacitor
- Author: Nishal K (github.com/nishal21)
- Source: https://github.com/nishal21/upi-Down
- Contact: nishal@nishal.dev
- License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (open source, non-commercial)
